subject: spanish

moments.title: Velazquez at court
moments.body: Velazquez becomes court painter to Philip IV at 24.
moments.takeaway: Spanish art's golden age was court art.

moments.title: Las Meninas
moments.body: Velazquez paints himself painting, the Infanta Margarita, courtiers and the reflected royal couple.
moments.takeaway: A court group portrait became a meditation on representation.

moments.title: Velazquez dies
moments.body: Velazquez dies after designing decorations for the marriage of Maria Theresa to Louis XIV.
moments.takeaway: Court painters served diplomacy as much as art.

now.title: Velazquez now
now.body: Las Meninas remains the Prado's central painting. Picasso's 58 variations (1957) put it back in dialogue with modern art.
now.open_questions: What other Spanish Golden Age painters deserve global attention?

reflection: A single painting keeps four centuries of viewers in conversation.
